title: 大壩施工導流~River diversion during dam construction
focus: 施工導流的洪水暴露、過流能力與階段轉換~Diversion flood exposure, hydraulic capacity and construction transitions
summary: 本課以大壩施工導流為入口，深入施工導流的洪水暴露、過流能力與階段轉換。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。~Using River diversion during dam construction as its entry point, this course examines diversion flood exposure, hydraulic capacity and construction transitions. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
example: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設每年超越機率0.05、各年獨立且平穩，三年內至少一次超越1−(1−0.05)³=0.142625即14.2625%；不代表季節施工窗口機率。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：SI制曼寧係數n的單位為s/m^(1/3)。假設矩形渠寬10 m、水深3 m、曼寧n=0.025、坡度0.001，A=30 m²、R=30/16=1.875 m，Q=AR^(2/3)S^0.5/n=57.701 m³/s；均勻流。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。 導流渠糙率敏感度固定寬10 m、水深3 m、坡度0.001，因此A=30 m²與R=1.875 m不變，只將曼寧n由0.025增至0.030 s/m^(1/3)。Q=AR^(2/3)S^0.5/n由57.701降至48.084 m³/s，約減少16.67%。這是指定水深下均勻流輸水能力的比較；若指定流量不變，應另解新水深，不能同時固定流量與水深。~This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume annual exceedance probability 0.05 with independent stationary years. At least one exceedance in three years has probability 0.142625, or 14.2625 percent, not a seasonal-window probability. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: The SI Manning coefficient n has units s/m^(1/3). Assume rectangular width 10 m, depth 3 m, Manning n=0.025 and slope 0.001. Area is 30 m² and radius 1.875 m, giving uniform-flow capacity approximately 57.701 m³/s. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters. Hold channel width 10 m, depth 3 m and slope 0.001 fixed, retaining A=30 m² and R=1.875 m, and increase only Manning n from 0.025 to 0.030 s/m^(1/3). Uniform-flow capacity Q=AR^(2/3)S^0.5/n falls from 57.701 to 48.084 m³/s, approximately 16.67%. This compares capacity at prescribed depth; prescribing unchanged discharge instead requires solving for a new depth.
history: 施工導流把暫時水工構造、洪水風險與永久工程施工階段連結，核心不是單一設計流量，而是每個轉換階段的水力能力、暴露時間與可驗證完成條件。重力壩設計專書提供水工建設與施工整合背景。 臨時圍堰與支撐開挖規劃規定發布，涵蓋風險與永久構造完整性。 土石壩施工標準章節更新，提供導流和基坑施工的一般背景。這些年份是技術出版節點，不代表某座壩的施工年表。課程從公開工法建立原創算例，地標僅用於對照不同壩型與環境；每項材料參數、荷載和允許條件仍需依工程調查與專案設計重新確定。~Construction diversion connects temporary hydraulic works, flood risk and permanent construction stages. Its core is not one discharge value but the capacity, exposure duration and verifiable completion conditions of each transition. Gravity-dam design guidance provides context for integrating hydraulic works and construction. Temporary-cofferdam and braced-excavation planning requirements are issued, covering risk and permanent-structure integrity. The embankment-construction standards chapter is updated, providing general diversion and excavation context. These years mark technical publications rather than construction events at a particular dam. The course develops original calculations from public engineering principles. Landmarks compare dam types and settings; material parameters, loads and admissible conditions still require project investigations and specific design. The examples do not assert that an unverified technique was used at a named structure.

units.anchor: 施工期洪水暴露~Construction-period flood exposure
units.title: 施工期洪水暴露~Construction-period flood exposure
units.mechanism: 施工導流的風險與暴露時間及洪水季節分布有關，重現期不是保證多久才發生一次。短期工程仍可能遇到大洪水，且後果隨開挖、圍堰和永久壩體所處階段改變。 假設每年超越機率0.05、各年獨立且平穩，三年內至少一次超越1−(1−0.05)³=0.142625即14.2625%；不代表季節施工窗口機率。 把全年機率直接按月份等比例縮小會忽略季節集中，連續年份的氣候相關性也會破壞獨立假設。即使超越機率相同，不同階段的損失與恢復時間仍可能完全不同。~Diversion risk depends on exposure duration and seasonal flood distribution. Return period is not a guaranteed waiting time, and consequences change as excavation, cofferdams and permanent works pass through different construction stages. Assume annual exceedance probability 0.05 with independent stationary years. At least one exceedance in three years has probability 0.142625, or 14.2625 percent, not a seasonal-window probability. Dividing annual probability in proportion to months ignores seasonality, and climate persistence violates independence. Equal exceedance probabilities can also correspond to very different losses and recovery times at different stages of construction.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設每年超越機率0.05、各年獨立且平穩，三年內至少一次超越1−(1−0.05)³=0.142625即14.2625%；不代表季節施工窗口機率。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume annual exceedance probability 0.05 with independent stationary years. At least one exceedance in three years has probability 0.142625, or 14.2625 percent, not a seasonal-window probability.
units.verify: 以施工階段對應水文資料期間，區分全年年最大值與特定月份事件；查核長期趨勢和上游調控變更，將每階段暴露、洪峰不確定度及淹水後果列成可追溯的風險表。另列洪水樣本的季節涵蓋。~Match construction stages to hydrologic records, distinguishing annual maxima from events in selected months. Check long-term trends and upstream regulation changes, recording stage exposure, peak uncertainty and inundation consequences in a traceable risk assessment. Document seasonal coverage of the flood sample separately.
units.failure: 把全年機率直接按月份等比例縮小會忽略季節集中，連續年份的氣候相關性也會破壞獨立假設。即使超越機率相同，不同階段的損失與恢復時間仍可能完全不同。~Dividing annual probability in proportion to months ignores seasonality, and climate persistence violates independence. Equal exceedance probabilities can also correspond to very different losses and recovery times at different stages of construction.
units.misconception: 二十年重現期洪水表示施工開始後前十九年都不可能發生。~A twenty-year return period means that flood cannot occur during the first nineteen years.
units.practice: 以施工期洪水暴露編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以施工階段對應水文資料期間，區分全年年最大值與特定月份事件；查核長期趨勢和上游調控變更，將每階段暴露、洪峰不確定度及淹水後果列成可追溯的風險表。另列洪水樣本的季節涵蓋。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for construction-period flood exposure, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Match construction stages to hydrologic records, distinguishing annual maxima from events in selected months. Check long-term trends and upstream regulation changes, recording stage exposure, peak uncertainty and inundation consequences in a traceable risk assessment. Document seasonal coverage of the flood sample separately.

units.anchor: 明渠導流的過水能力~Open-channel diversion capacity
units.title: 明渠導流的過水能力~Open-channel diversion capacity
units.mechanism: 明渠能力取決於斷面、水力半徑、坡度與粗糙度，不能只看開挖面積。均勻流公式可初估穩定長渠，但入口、彎道和下游回水需要另行評估。 SI制曼寧係數n的單位為s/m^(1/3)。假設矩形渠寬10 m、水深3 m、曼寧n=0.025、坡度0.001，A=30 m²、R=30/16=1.875 m，Q=AR^(2/3)S^0.5/n=57.701 m³/s；均勻流。 局部收縮或彎道可能先控制水位，堆料和漂流物又會降低有效斷面。若只增加平均水深來滿足公式流量，可能漏掉局部溢頂或岸坡沖蝕問題。~Open-channel capacity depends on section, hydraulic radius, slope and roughness, not excavated area alone. Uniform-flow relations estimate a long stable reach, while entrance effects, bends and downstream backwater require separate analysis. The SI Manning coefficient n has units s/m^(1/3). Assume rectangular width 10 m, depth 3 m, Manning n=0.025 and slope 0.001. Area is 30 m² and radius 1.875 m, giving uniform-flow capacity approximately 57.701 m³/s. A contraction or bend can control stage before the uniform reach does, while stored material and debris reduce effective area. Increasing assumed average depth to meet discharge can overlook local overtopping or bank erosion.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：SI制曼寧係數n的單位為s/m^(1/3)。假設矩形渠寬10 m、水深3 m、曼寧n=0.025、坡度0.001，A=30 m²、R=30/16=1.875 m，Q=AR^(2/3)S^0.5/n=57.701 m³/s；均勻流。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: The SI Manning coefficient n has units s/m^(1/3). Assume rectangular width 10 m, depth 3 m, Manning n=0.025 and slope 0.001. Area is 30 m² and radius 1.875 m, giving uniform-flow capacity approximately 57.701 m³/s.
units.verify: 用實測縱斷面和水面線確認是否接近均勻流，分段記錄粗糙度與阻水物；以不同尾水條件重算回水，並用流速量測核對斷面流量，不能將渠底坡直接當所有情境的能量坡。~Check measured bed and water-surface profiles for near-uniform flow, recording roughness and obstructions by reach. Recalculate backwater for different tailwaters and verify section discharge with velocities rather than assuming bed slope always equals energy slope.
units.failure: 局部收縮或彎道可能先控制水位，堆料和漂流物又會降低有效斷面。若只增加平均水深來滿足公式流量，可能漏掉局部溢頂或岸坡沖蝕問題。~A contraction or bend can control stage before the uniform reach does, while stored material and debris reduce effective area. Increasing assumed average depth to meet discharge can overlook local overtopping or bank erosion.
units.misconception: 導流明渠只要開挖面積相同，就一定具有相同的過流能力。~Diversion channels with equal excavated area necessarily have identical flow capacity.
units.practice: 以明渠導流的過水能力編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。用實測縱斷面和水面線確認是否接近均勻流，分段記錄粗糙度與阻水物；以不同尾水條件重算回水，並用流速量測核對斷面流量，不能將渠底坡直接當所有情境的能量坡。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for open-channel diversion capacity, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check measured bed and water-surface profiles for near-uniform flow, recording roughness and obstructions by reach. Recalculate backwater for different tailwaters and verify section discharge with velocities rather than assuming bed slope always equals energy slope.

units.anchor: 滿流隧洞的沿程損失~Full-flow tunnel friction loss
units.title: 滿流隧洞的沿程損失~Full-flow tunnel friction loss
units.mechanism: 導流隧洞在滿流與自由水面流之間可能轉換，水力邊界先於公式選擇。滿管沿程損失與速度平方成正比，糙率和局部缺陷會改變所需上下游能量差。 取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設滿流圓洞直徑6 m、長500 m、Darcy摩阻係數0.02、流量100 m³/s，v=3.537 m/s，hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g)=1.063 m；不含入口出口損失。 使用滿管公式卻忽略洞內自由水面和空氣囊會誤估能力，Darcy與Fanning係數混用又會差四倍。轉換流況可能出現脈動，平均能量線不能完全描述瞬間壓力。~Diversion tunnels may transition between free-surface and pressurized flow, so boundary classification precedes equation choice. Full-flow friction scales with velocity squared, and roughness or defects change the required upstream-downstream energy difference. Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume full circular diameter 6 m, length 500 m, Darcy factor 0.02 and discharge 100 m³/s. Velocity is 3.537 m/s and friction loss 1.063 m, excluding entrance and exit losses. Applying full-pipe relations despite free surfaces or air pockets misstates capacity, and confusing Darcy with Fanning factors introduces a factor of four. Flow transitions can pulsate, beyond what an average energy line describes.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設滿流圓洞直徑6 m、長500 m、Darcy摩阻係數0.02、流量100 m³/s，v=3.537 m/s，hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g)=1.063 m；不含入口出口損失。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume full circular diameter 6 m, length 500 m, Darcy factor 0.02 and discharge 100 m³/s. Velocity is 3.537 m/s and friction loss 1.063 m, excluding entrance and exit losses.
units.verify: 沿洞線建立壓力與能量線，確認洞頂是否持續被壓力水面覆蓋；把摩阻係數和接縫突出物分開做敏感度，並比對進出口水位與流量，檢查自由流轉滿流的遲滯。~Construct pressure and energy lines and verify whether the crown remains pressurized. Separate friction sensitivity from protruding joints, compare inlet and outlet levels with discharge, and investigate hysteresis during transitions between free-surface and full flow.
units.failure: 使用滿管公式卻忽略洞內自由水面和空氣囊會誤估能力，Darcy與Fanning係數混用又會差四倍。轉換流況可能出現脈動，平均能量線不能完全描述瞬間壓力。~Applying full-pipe relations despite free surfaces or air pockets misstates capacity, and confusing Darcy with Fanning factors introduces a factor of four. Flow transitions can pulsate, beyond what an average energy line describes.
units.misconception: 導流隧洞的摩阻係數不分Darcy或Fanning定義都能直接代入同一公式。~Darcy and Fanning friction factors can be used interchangeably in the same tunnel formula.
units.practice: 以滿流隧洞的沿程損失編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。沿洞線建立壓力與能量線，確認洞頂是否持續被壓力水面覆蓋；把摩阻係數和接縫突出物分開做敏感度，並比對進出口水位與流量，檢查自由流轉滿流的遲滯。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for full-flow tunnel friction loss, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Construct pressure and energy lines and verify whether the crown remains pressurized. Separate friction sensitivity from protruding joints, compare inlet and outlet levels with discharge, and investigate hysteresis during transitions between free-surface and full flow.

units.anchor: 入口局部損失與堵塞~Entrance loss and obstruction
units.title: 入口局部損失與堵塞~Entrance loss and obstruction
units.mechanism: 入口把河道動能重新分配到隧洞或渠道，局部損失不只由截面大小決定。漂流物改變收縮和有效面積，速度增加又會放大損失，形成非線性的能力下降。 取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設原入口流速3 m/s、損失係數K=0.5，局部損失Kv²/(2g)=0.2294 m；同流量下有效面積減20%，速度3.75 m/s，若K不變損失增56.25%。 漂流物會同時改變K與面積，固定係數估算可能低估實際損失。偏流造成單側壓力與沖刷，即使總流量尚可，也可能已影響入口結構或鄰近岸坡。~An entrance redistributes river flow into a tunnel or channel, with losses controlled by more than area. Debris changes contraction and effective opening, increasing velocity and amplifying losses nonlinearly as capacity declines. Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume entrance velocity 3 m/s and loss coefficient 0.5, giving loss 0.2294 m. At constant discharge, twenty-percent area reduction raises velocity to 3.75 m/s and loss by 56.25 percent if K is unchanged. Debris changes both loss coefficient and area, so a fixed coefficient can understate deterioration. Asymmetric flow creates one-sided pressure and scour even while total discharge appears adequate, affecting the entrance and adjacent banks.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設原入口流速3 m/s、損失係數K=0.5，局部損失Kv²/(2g)=0.2294 m；同流量下有效面積減20%，速度3.75 m/s，若K不變損失增56.25%。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume entrance velocity 3 m/s and loss coefficient 0.5, giving loss 0.2294 m. At constant discharge, twenty-percent area reduction raises velocity to 3.75 m/s and loss by 56.25 percent if K is unchanged.
units.verify: 以入口上下游水位及局部流速重建能量差，記錄漂流物覆蓋比例和入流角度；用不同堵塞圖樣比較損失，而非只用總堵塞面積，確認是否出現偏流、旋渦與空氣捲入。檢查堵塞圖樣是否改變旋渦位置。~Reconstruct head loss from upstream and downstream levels and local velocity, recording debris coverage and approach angle. Compare different blockage patterns rather than total area alone, identifying asymmetric flow, vortices and air entrainment. Check whether blockage patterns shift vortex locations.

Asymmetric flow creates one-sided pressure and scour even while total discharge appears adequate, affecting the entrance and adjacent banks.
units.misconception: 入口有效面積減少百分之二十，水頭損失也一定只增加百分之二十。~Reducing entrance area by twenty percent always raises head loss by only twenty percent.
units.practice: 以入口局部損失與堵塞編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以入口上下游水位及局部流速重建能量差，記錄漂流物覆蓋比例和入流角度；用不同堵塞圖樣比較損失，而非只用總堵塞面積，確認是否出現偏流、旋渦與空氣捲入。檢查堵塞圖樣是否改變旋渦位置。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for entrance loss and obstruction, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Reconstruct head loss from upstream and downstream levels and local velocity, recording debris coverage and approach angle. Compare different blockage patterns rather than total area alone, identifying asymmetric flow, vortices and air entrainment. Check whether blockage patterns shift vortex locations.

units.anchor: 圍堰底部的揚壓作用~Cofferdam base uplift
units.title: 圍堰底部的揚壓作用~Cofferdam base uplift
units.mechanism: 圍堰暫時擋水不代表可忽略滲流，基底孔壓會降低有效法向力並影響抗滑。簡化三角揚壓只適用所列邊界，排水、截水和分層地基會改變實際分布。 取淡水單位重γw=9.81 kN/m³。假設每米堰長底寬12 m、上游水頭8 m、下游0 m且線性衰減，揚力0.5×9.81×8×12=470.88 kN/m；堰重900 kN/m則有效重429.12 kN/m。 停抽後孔壓可能比外水位變動更快影響穩定，基底局部高壓也會被平均值掩蓋。若將堰體自重全部當摩擦法向力，會高估可動用抗滑能力。~Temporary cofferdams still experience seepage, and base pressure reduces effective normal force and sliding resistance. A triangular uplift diagram applies only to stated boundaries; drains, cutoffs and layered foundations alter the actual distribution. Use freshwater unit weight γw=9.81 kN/m³. Assume twelve-metre base, upstream head eight metres, zero downstream head and linear decline. Uplift is 470.88 kN/m; weight 900 kN/m leaves effective normal weight 429.12 kN/m before other forces. Pressure after pumping interruption can quickly change stability, and local high pressures disappear in averages. Treating total cofferdam weight as frictional normal force overestimates resistance because uplift reduces effective contact loading.

units.anchor: 收縮流與沖刷相似~Contraction flow and scour similarity
units.title: 收縮流與沖刷相似~Contraction flow and scour similarity
units.mechanism: 導流造成的急流與回流會重新分配河床剪力，水深弗勞德數只能描述重力慣性比例。沖刷還取決於顆粒、尾水與流況歷程，不能只憑一個無因次數直接推定深度。 取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設局部流速5 m/s、水深2 m，Fr=v/sqrt(gy)=1.129；教學自由水面尺度，未給粒徑與持續時間，因此不推算沖刷深度。 平均斷面流速可能漏掉貼岸高速射流，護底本身又會把沖刷轉移到末端。以某一瞬間無明顯變化判定穩定，可能忽略長時間淘刷或洪水退水期的破壞。~Diversion-induced jets and recirculation redistribute bed stress. units.anchor: 截流缺口的流速放大~Closure-gap velocity amplification
units.title: 截流缺口的流速放大~Closure-gap velocity amplification
units.mechanism: 截流過程使剩餘缺口逐步縮小，局部流速和水面差會隨分流比例共同變動。固定流量除面積可示範敏感性，但實際河水可能轉入導流通道或上游暫存。 取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設瞬間缺口流量120 m³/s、水深4 m、寬由12降至8 m且分流暫不變，平均速度由2.5增至3.75 m/s；動能水頭由0.3186增至0.7167 m。 缺口縮窄也會抬高水頭並改變導流分配，流速未必按面積倒數持續上升。只使用上一階段的水深與流量，可能低估局部射流、床面變形和材料受力。~Closure progressively narrows the remaining gap, changing velocity and head difference together with flow partition. Constant discharge divided by area illustrates sensitivity, while actual water may shift into diversion works or upstream storage. Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume instantaneous gap flow 120 m³/s at depth four metres and width reducing from twelve to eight metres without repartition. Mean velocity rises from 2.5 to 3.75 m/s and velocity head from 0.3186 to 0.7167 m. units.anchor: 洪峰暫存與水位上升~Flood storage and stage rise
units.title: 洪峰暫存與水位上升~Flood storage and stage rise
units.mechanism: 導流設施的瞬時出流小於洪峰時，差額會累積在上游暫存區。容量檢核需積分整個超額歷線，不能只比較洪峰差，也不能假定所有可見河谷空間都可用於儲洪。 假設超過導流能力的流量歷線為底寬2 h、峰值60 m³/s三角形，所需暫存0.5×7200×60=216000 m³；若有效面積120000 m²恆定，水位升1.8 m。 出流能力通常隨水位上升改變，固定能力三角示例可能高估或低估暫存。洪水期間地形被沖淤改變也會改寫容量，不能把一次測量曲線當作永遠有效。~When diversion outflow falls below inflow, excess accumulates upstream. Required storage is 216000 m³; constant effective surface area 120000 m² gives stage rise 1.8 m, excluding changing outlet capacity. Outflow capacity usually changes with stage, making the fixed-capacity triangle potentially conservative or unconservative. Erosion and deposition can also alter storage during a flood, so one surveyed relation is not permanently valid.

units.anchor: 基坑降水與滲流供給~Excavation dewatering and seepage supply
units.title: 基坑降水與滲流供給~Excavation dewatering and seepage supply
units.mechanism: 圍堰內基坑降水會增加外側水體的水頭差，抽水需求可能隨開挖深度增加。達西估算提供連續介質量級，但岩體裂隙、各向異性與河床補注需要專門辨認。 假設等效透水係數2×10⁻⁵ m/s、過流面積300 m²、水頭差10 m、路徑20 m，Q=kAΔh/L=0.003 m³/s即3 L/s；一維穩態且無集中裂隙。 抽水流量增加可能來自裂隙被開挖接通或施工水混入，未必是整體k變大。若只提高抽排量而不查孔壓與細料，可能掩蓋基底有效應力或侵蝕條件的改變。~Dewatering inside a cofferdam increases head difference from the river, so pumping demand can grow with excavation depth. One-dimensional steady Darcy flow is 0.003 m³/s or three litres per second, excluding concentrated fractures. Higher pumping can reflect newly exposed fractures or process water rather than increased bulk permeability. Focusing on discharge without pressures and transported fines can conceal changes in base effective stress or internal-erosion conditions.

units.anchor: 導流切換與關鍵工期~Diversion transitions and critical duration
units.title: 導流切換與關鍵工期~Diversion transitions and critical duration
units.mechanism: 導流切換把水工能力和施工排程連在一起，某項延誤會讓高暴露階段跨入不同水文季節。關鍵路徑需表示真正的前置關係，並與可回復狀態和監測交接共同審查。 假設入口工程18 days、隧洞檢查12 days可平行，兩者完成後切換5 days，再驗證3 days，總期max(18,12)+5+3=26 days；入口延誤4 days使總期30 days。 名義平行的工作可能共享設備或通道，隱藏資源限制會使計算工期過短。若把驗證當成可壓縮空檔，可能在尚未證明新通道能力時就失去原來的導流冗餘。~Diversion transitions couple hydraulic capacity with scheduling, and delays can carry vulnerable stages into a different hydrologic season. Critical paths must represent actual dependencies and be reviewed with recoverable states and monitoring handover requirements. Assume entrance work eighteen days and tunnel checks twelve days run in parallel, followed by transition five days and verification three days. Duration is 26 days; four-day entrance delay increases it to thirty days. Nominally parallel tasks may share equipment or access, so hidden resource constraints shorten calculated duration unrealistically. Treating verification as expendable slack can remove previous diversion redundancy before the new route has demonstrated capacity.

土石壩施工標準章節更新，提供導流和基坑施工的一般背景。~The embankment-construction standards chapter is updated, providing general diversion and excavation context.
